experiment: USEF-TSE audio-only enrollment fusion with original DiariZen Task 1 RTTM
scope: EAR-1 dev, seven sessions, D1 and R1
enrollment_source: long predicted-solo regions of original DiariZen RTTM, up to 8 seconds per known speaker
separation_model: USEF-TSE with TF-GridNet backbone, WHAMR! checkpoint, 8 kHz
environment: ear1-usef-tse for extraction; ear1-funasr for VAD and CAM++ verification; ear1-pyannote for scoring
target_extraction: 6 s windows with 1 s overlap and crossfade, full original recording, shared track gain to avoid PCM16 clipping
candidate: target VAD plus target/mix energy ratio >=0.12, original DiariZen exactly one other speaker, at least 1.2 s
scoring: full audio UEM including silence, collar 0, overlap scored, fixed full-audio mapping for region breakdown
